textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: µ₀≈4π×10⁻⁷ T·m/A is the stated model datum, not an exact physical constant; r=5cm=1/20m. The π cancels, giving4µT/A. Signed tangential component tracks current sign. Earth/other fields excluded; zero current selects no wire-field direction.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Manual multiplication by4. A negative sign denotes direction; the magnitude at−2A is8µT.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Classical fixed-momentum perpendicular motion; |q|vB=mv²/r and mv/|q|=.12T·m. Positive B domain prevents division by zero; speed unchanged by magnetic force. Sign of q changes curvature sense, not radius.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Divide12 by1 or3; .12m=12cm. Original published version2 maps to new version3/base2, independently checked.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Angle is between B and oriented surface normal. BA=.3T×.02m²=.006Wb=6mWb. cos120°=−1/2 and cos60°=+1/2. Flux is signed;90° gives0.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Exact known-angle arithmetic requires no calculator. Machine answers−2.9999999999999987/+3.000000000000001 are separately compared to a frozen, consumer-free Node process, never equated exactly to the rational−3/+3.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Stationary10-turn coil, fixed area.05m², fixed normal parallel to reference field; NA=.5m². ε=−NA dB/dt, and T·m²/s=Wb/s=V. Open circuit can show emf without current.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Halving and signed multiplication. Existing numeric grader accepts−1.5; no new tolerance supplied.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Already-linked flux Ψ=NΦ changes by+2Wb; fixed orientation and strictly positive interval. Average emf−ΔΨ/Δt; no second multiplication byN.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Division by2 or1/2 is exact. Average is distinguished from instantaneous value; the supplied interval does not determine arbitrary instantaneous emf.

textMathManualReview.assumptionsAndDimensions: Closed2Ω circuit with self-inductance neglected; orient current consistently with the normal. ε=−dΨ/dt andI=ε/R. Lenz opposes the change, not invariably the external field.
textMathManualReview.manualArithmeticAndPedagogy: Signed division by2, with Wb/s=V andV/Ω=A. Zero variation correctly returns zero in the model.
